sloka: एवमुक्तास्तत: सर्वे तत्र तस्थु: समन्तत: ।भरतो यत्र धूमाग्रं तत्र दृष्टिं समादधात् ॥ २.९३.२६॥
transliteration: evamuktāstata: sarve tatra tasthu: samantata: ।bharato yatra dhūmāgraṁ tatra dṛṣṭiṁ samādadhāt ॥ 2.93.26॥

translations.english: At this command, all of them halted. Then Bharata fixed his gaze on the source of the smoke.
